name: Maverick Boost - Virus Affect
desc: Send 1 "Zero" monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Maverick Hunter - Zero Virus" from your Extra Deck. You can banish this card from the GY; add 1 "Maverick Hunter - Zero" from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Maverick Boost - Virus Affect" once per turn.
strings: Special Summon Zero Virus from Extra Deck
Add Maverick Hunter - Zero to hand
